title: Osthole targets doublecortin like kinase 1 (DCLK1/DCAMKL1) in macrophages to inhibit NF-kappaB-mediated inflammation and alleviate atherosclerosis.
authors: Shen, Sirui; Luo, Wu; Guan, Yue; Yang, Yudie; Chen, Pan; Xu, Jiaqi; Zhou, Tong; Chen, Yongping; Liang, Guang
one_liner_zh: 该文研究osthole靶向DCLK1抑制NF-κB介导的炎症以缓解动脉粥样硬化，虽涉及分子对接但核心是药物-蛋白互作与炎症通路，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND AND PURPOSE: Atherosclerosis is a chronic inflammatory disease. Targeting inflammatory pathways provides a promising avenue to treat atherosclerosis. Osthole (OS), isolated from the Cnidium plant, has been reported diverse pharmacological activities, including anti-cancer, anti-oxidant, neuroprotective, anti-osteoporosis and anti-inflammatory effects. However, the role on atherosclerosis and molecular targets of osthole remains unclear. We aimed to explore the anti-atherosclerosis role of osthole and investigate the underlying molecular mechanism. EXPERIMENTAL APPROACH: Mouse primary peritoneal macrophages (MPMs) were isolated and treated with oxLDL in vitro. Protein microarray and molecular docking were used to identify the target/s of osthole. ApoE(-/-) mice were fed with a high-fat diet (HFD) for 8 weeks to induce atherosclerosis. KEY RESULTS: Osthole inhibited the inflammatory factor secretion induced by oxLDL and then reduced oxLDL uptake in MPMs. In vivo, osthole administration alleviated atherosclerotic plaque formation and inflammatory response in HFD-fed ApoE(-/-) mice. Mechanistically, protein microarray incubated with biotin-labelled osthole identified doublecortin like kinase 1 (DCLK1/DCAMKL1) as the top-ranked binding protein of osthole. Osthole directly bound to DCLK1 at I396 and L518 sites, inhibited the phosphorylation of DCLK1, and then prevented its interaction with inhibitor of nuclear factor kappa B kinase subunit beta (IKKbeta). Through targeting DCLK1, osthole suppressed NF-kappaB pathway activation and inflammatory responses in both MPMs and aortic lesions. CONCLUSION AND IMPLICATIONS: Taken together, our findings show the therapeutic potential of osthole against inflammatory atherosclerosis and establish a foundation for targeting DCLK1 therapy in atherosclerosis.
abstract_zh: 背景与目的：动脉粥样硬化是一种慢性炎症性疾病。靶向炎症通路为治疗动脉粥样硬化提供了有前景的途径。蛇床子素（Osthole, OS），分离自蛇床属植物，已被报道具有多种药理活性，包括抗癌、抗氧化、神经保护、抗骨质疏松和抗炎作用。然而，蛇床子素在动脉粥样硬化中的作用及其分子靶点仍不清楚。我们旨在探讨蛇床子素的抗动脉粥样硬化作用，并研究其潜在的分子机制。实验方法：分离小鼠原代腹腔巨噬细胞（MPMs），并在体外用oxLDL处理。使用蛋白质微阵列和分子对接 (molecular docking) 来鉴定蛇床子素的靶点。给ApoE(-/-)小鼠喂食高脂饮食（HFD）8周以诱导动脉粥样硬化。关键结果：蛇床子素抑制了oxLDL诱导的炎症因子分泌，进而减少了MPMs对oxLDL的摄取。在体内，蛇床子素给药减轻了HFD喂养的ApoE(-/-)小鼠的动脉粥样硬化斑块形成和炎症反应。机制上，用生物素标记的蛇床子素孵育的蛋白质微阵列鉴定出双皮质素样激酶1（DCLK1/DCAMKL1）为蛇床子素排名最高的结合蛋白。蛇床子素直接结合DCLK1的I396和L518位点，抑制DCLK1的磷酸化，进而阻止其与核因子κB激酶亚基β抑制剂（IKKbeta）的相互作用。通过靶向DCLK1，蛇床子素抑制了MPMs和主动脉病变中的NF-kappaB通路激活和炎症反应。结论与意义：综上所述，我们的发现显示了蛇床子素对抗炎症性动脉粥样硬化的治疗潜力，并为在动脉粥样硬化中靶向DCLK1治疗奠定了基础。
